name: IC Interface Serial — 3.3V, UART/serial — DIP
description: Serial interface ICs operating at 3.3V in through-hole DIP packaging using the DIP-8_W7.62mm footprint for UART applications.
selection_hints: Requires a 3.3V UART or serial interface IC.
Requires through-hole DIP assembly using the DIP-8_W7.62mm footprint.
Selecting from Tier A parts like SP3481CP, SP3481EP, SP3485CP, or SP3485EP.
avoid_when: Surface-mount packaging is required rather than through-hole DIP.
Operating voltages other than 3.3V are needed.
The required footprint is not DIP-8_W7.62mm.
